# Official MineLabs Network SMP Modpack

This Modpack is required to play on MineLabs Network Forge Server. ([Discord](https://discord.gg/5G2kBkuC9P))



MineLabs focuses on the classic survival mode of Minecraft, which is supplemented with the ingenious mod “Create” by simibubi. This offers a variety of tools and blocks for building, decoration and aesthetic automation. If you can't imagine anything, you should take a look here:


<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/rR8W-f9YhYA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Also Create Aeronautics was finally released:


<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/SO8tpWfZjGk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


To ensure that the “vanilla experience” remains exciting for long-established Minecraft veterans, the in-house ModPack comes with a variety of small mods that introduce a new twist and interesting mechanics. Some notable mods:



- Terralith
- Let's do Mods
- Croptopia
- Tom's Simple Storage Mod
- Farmer's Delight
- Aquaculture 2 



With a total of over 200 mods, there is something for everyone.
